Account snapshot:
- Company: Sunstone Aperture (mid-market SaaS, product analytics platform). Building user-facing insights and in-app assistants for product managers and customer success.
- Contact(s): VP Product - Maya Lind (primary), Head of Security - Aaron Becker, Platform Eng Lead - Nila Rao.
- Business driver: faster time-to-insight for customers; move from rule-based search to a natural-language assistant + reranking for analytics queries.
- Initial interest path: started with Hosted API eval (Jan 2026 demo), scoped POC for 6 weeks, then decided to evaluate Dedicated for predictable latency and VPC requirements.
POC & Tech requirements (from discovery/demos):
- Workload: conversational assistant + document search/reranking across 120M docs (indexing + embeddings).
- Latency targets: p95 generation <= 300ms for short prompts (assistive UI); p95 reranking <= 200ms for top-10 rerank.
- Throughput: target 300-500 requests/sec at peak, burst support to 1k for release events.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to reduce unit cost.
- Model preferences: prefer open variants (quantized) with fallback to smaller family for non-critical queries. Want ability to pin model versions for rollouts.
Security & Compliance notes (heavy weighting):
- Requirements called out during security screening: SOC2 Type II evidence, SSO/SAML integration with Okta, audit logging for all API calls, retention controls for user content, KMS/HSM for key management, data residency for US & EU customers.
- Specific asks: separate audit log retention 7+ years, user content retention default 90 days but configurable; VPC peering and private endpoints mandatory for Dedicated; ability to export raw request logs for compliance investigations.
- Quote from Aaron Becker (Head of Security): "We need a chain-of-custody for sensitive requests and immutable audit trails — SOC2 artifacts and live demo of audit log flow are blockers."
